metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2026 · The Death of Robin Hood
metas.description: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 1988 · Cocktail
metas.description: A talented New York City bartender takes a job at a bar in Jamaica and falls in love.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Lynley
metas.description: DI Thomas Lynley and DS Barbara Havers form an unlikely police detective duo. Their contrasting backgrounds create tension, but they unite to solve crimes, navigating class and gender issues.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2010 · Mokhtarnameh
metas.description: Mukhtar Thaqafi was a Shiite Muslim leader who sets up a rebellion movement in 686 A.D in the town of Kufa to avenge the martyrdom of Hussain (grandson of Islamic Prophet Muhammad).

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2017 · Koombiyo
metas.description: 35 year old bachelor Jehan and his partner in crime Priyantha try to exploit the loopholes in the law in order to make a living.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2021 · Come from Away
metas.description: 7,000 passengers are stranded after the 9/11 terrorist attacks in a small town in Newfoundland, where they were housed and welcomed. Filmed live on stage at the Gerald Schoenfeld Theater in New York City.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Wicker
metas.description: An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Maruva Tarama
metas.description: At a Goa restaurant, Anvi meets a naval officer for arranged marriage talks. Though beautiful and from a wealthy family, she hides a secret - her heart belongs to another. She declines his proposal.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2022 · Shining Girls
metas.description: Years after a brutal attack left her in a constantly shifting reality, Kirby Mazrachi learns that a recent murder is linked to her assault. She teams with a veteran reporter to understand her ever-changing present and confront her...

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2017 · Columbus
metas.description: A Korean-born man finds himself stuck in Columbus, Indiana, where his architect father is in a coma. The man meets a young woman who wants to stay in Columbus with her mother, a recovering addict, instead of pursuing her own dreams.

metas.name: ★ 6.6 · 2026 · Lord of the Flies
metas.description: A plane crash strands a group of British boys on an unoccupied tropical island, where they gradually slide into anarchy as social conventions disappear and attempts at responsible rule divide them into warring factions.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · Garividi Lakshmi
metas.description: A gifted folk singer from North Andhra rises to fame through her captivating voice and Burra Katha performances, only to mysteriously disappear at the height of her popularity. Years later, a man sets out to unravel the mystery. What happened to Garividi Lakshmi?

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2026 · The Dog Stars
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2019 · Wayne
metas.description: Wayne, a 16-year-old with a heart of gold, sets out on a small two-stroke road bike from Boston to Florida with his new friend Del to retrieve the '79 Trans-Am that was stolen from his father before he died.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2001 · The Inspector Lynley Mysteries
metas.description: British crime investigation series based around aristocratic, Oxford-educated Detective Inspector Thomas Lynley and his working-class assistant Sergeant Barbara Havers.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1961 · The Misfits
metas.description: A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · The Intern
metas.description: A story about what happens when  Seon-wu, the CEO of a fashion company who is more passionate than anyone when it comes to work, hires Ki-ho, who has a wealth of life experience, as a silver intern.

metas.name: 2026 · Wildwood
metas.description: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.

metas.name: 2026 · You+Me - Against the World
metas.description: Alma Lancaster, conceals her filmmaking ambitions from her rich family who believe she's in law school. She falls for rebel Vadim Arcadi, while creating a student film. Someone observes, poised to reveal secrets that could destroy...

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2026 · Portobello
metas.description: In the early '80s, Enzo Tortora is one of the most beloved figures on Italian television. But in the midst of Italy's war against organized crime, Enzo's life is upended when he's falsely connected to the notorious Camorra criminal ring.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Early Spring
metas.description: Fresh graduate Shang Zhitao joins a top global ad agency as a rookie. Her blunt boss Luan Nian tells her to quit on day one, but she perseveres through pressure and challenges to become a skilled professional.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 2021 · Professor T
metas.description: Professor Jasper Tempest, a genius Cambridge University criminologist with OCD and an overbearing mother, assists the police in solving crime.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2020 · Deadwater Fell
metas.description: When a seemingly perfect and happy family is murdered by someone they knew and trusted, cracks appear on the surface of a supposedly idyllic community.
